No content about López Obrador, no economic governance content, no questions applicable.","exclusion_reason":"Institutional header boilerplate only; no substantive content about the ruler, his policies, or governance."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0002","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.5","5B.8"],"relevance_strength":"pivotal","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0003","unit-0004","unit-0005","unit-0006","unit-0007"],"explanation":"Executive summary section describes López Obrador's 2018 electoral victory with 53.2% vote share and MORENA's debut as governing party. Explicitly covers 'austeridad republicana,' social programs (Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores), and anti-corruption rhetoric ('no robar'). Directly maps to broad-based prosperity agenda (5B.1), anti-corruption stance (5B.5), and social program distribution focus (5B.8). Core 2018 mandate foundation for all subsequent governance evaluation.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0003","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"weak","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0002","unit-0004"],"explanation":"Covers López Obrador's 2006 electoral defeat and his declaration as 'presidente legítimo' with parallel 'Gobierno alterno.' Discusses his challenge to electoral institutions and claims of 'fraude.' Institutional legitimacy concerns bear tangentially on rule-of-law questions (5B.4, 5B.7) and anti-corruption credibility (5B.5), but primary focus is electoral dispute rather than substantive economic governance actions. Weak but not zero relevance for governance evaluation.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0004","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0003","unit-0005"],"explanation":"Describes López Obrador's 2012 presidential platform explicitly calling for an end to 'neoporfirismo de corrupción, impunidad y privilegios,' opposition to neoliberalism, and protection of Pemex from privatization. Economic governance positions clearly articulated: macroeconomic discipline, rejection of false alternation, and commitment to sovereignty over strategic sectors. Material relevance to broad-based prosperity agenda (5B.1), macroeconomic rules (5B.3), fair competition/rule-of-law (5B.4, 5B.7).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0005","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.2","5B.3","5B.4","5B.5","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9"],"relevance_strength":"pivotal","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0004","unit-0006"],"explanation":"Detailed 2018 electoral program coverage: 'austeridad republicana' without tax increases or new debt, universal pension 1500 pesos monthly, gasoline price reduction, energy self-sufficiency, anti-corruption from Los Pinos, free trade discipline and macroeconomic stability commitment, youth program 'Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro,' Santa Lucía Airport vs NAIM, border migrants visas. Directly addresses all key economic governance dimensions: prosperity agenda (5B.1), professional appointments (5B.2), macroeconomic rules (5B.3), fair competition (5B.4), anti-corruption (5B.5), infrastructure/budget quality (5B.6), distribution (5B.8), and shock response (5B.9).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0006","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.5"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0005","unit-0007"],"explanation":"Describes 2018-2024 government program as 'socialdemocracia pragmática' assuming free market orthodoxies, macroeconomic stability, budget discipline, and peso flotation, combined with rejection of privatization and prioritization of national production. Promises to fight corruption and privilege from Los Pinos with 'justicia sin venganza.' Material relevance to prosperity agenda (5B.1), macroeconomic rules (5B.3), and anti-corruption enforcement (5B.5). Shows economic policy positioning at start of governance period.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0007","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.9"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0006","unit-0008"],"explanation":"Covers USMCA trade agreement (successor to NAFTA), López Obrador's positive assessment of the new treaty, and the migrant caravan crisis with Trump's border threats. External economic context: trade agreement and sanctions/shocks dimension. López Obrador's trade policy positions and responses to external economic pressures bear on macroeconomic management (5B.3) and shock response (5B.9). Part of the economic governance context.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0008","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Early biography: family origins, 1953 birth in Tepetitán Macuspana Tabasco, 1969 accidental shooting death of brother José Ramón, relocation to Palenque Chiapas, father as campesino and Pemex deposit watchman, mother as Spanish immigrant. Pure personal biographical content with no governance relevance.","exclusion_reason":"Pure personal/family biography predating any political or economic decision-making; no governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0009","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Early political career: 1972 UNAM Political Sciences enrollment, Carlos Pellicer 1976 campaign involvement, poetry and Marxism readings. No economic governance content, no policy positions, no budgetary or fiscal decisions.","exclusion_reason":"Early political socialization and student period; no economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0010","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Career details: INI delegation La Chontalpa, COPLAMAR, university teaching in Tabasco, 1980 marriage to Rocío Beltrán Medina, three sons born 1982/1987/1991, CEPES director role, PRI state committee president Tabasco 1983 and dismissal November 1983. Personal career progression with no economic governance policy content.","exclusion_reason":"Party functionary career details; no substantive economic governance policy positions."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0011","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"More career functionary detail: 1984 return to Mexico City INCO position, 1986 book on Tabasco history 1810-1867, 1987 UNAM graduation with thesis on Mexican state formation 1821-1867, joining Corriente Democrática in 1987. Pure career/academic content with no economic governance relevance.","exclusion_reason":"Career functionary period and academic output; no economic governance policy content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0012","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"weak","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0013","unit-0014"],"explanation":"1988 electoral fraud allegations: 'Fraude del sistema' in federal elections, Frente Democrático Nacional coalition, Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas presidential candidacy, Tabasco gubernatorial contest. López Obrador's fraud allegations and 'Tabasco víctima del fraude' 1990 book. Primarily about electoral politics, with tangential relevance to rule of law (5B.7) and anti-corruption (5B.5) credibility given pattern of fraud allegations against rivals.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0013","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"PRD founding May 5 1989, López Obrador as Tabasco PRD president, 1991-1992 'éxodo por la democracia' march from Villahermosa to Zócalo protesting municipal election fraud. Institutional opposition activity and electoral fraud protest, no substantive economic governance policy content.","exclusion_reason":"Party founding and democratic march protesting electoral fraud; no substantive economic governance policy."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0014","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"weak","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0013","unit-0015"],"explanation":"1994 Tabasco gubernatorial election, Roberto Madrazo victory 57.5%, fraud allegations, 1995 Caravana por la democracia, FOBAPROA critique (the bank rescue fund López Obrador called 'the biggest fraud in history after the Conquest'), PRD national committee president election July 1996 with 73.9% vote. FOBAPROA is a major economic governance event. Anti-corruption critique of financial sector rescue has tangential relevance to 5B.5 and 5B.7, but primarily retrospective political critique.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0015","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"weak","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0014","unit-0016"],"explanation":"PRD national president July 1996 through 1999, Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas DF head of government 1997, electoral gains in Zacatecas Tlaxcala Baja California Sur, FOBAPROA expediente abierto book publication. Continued anti-corruption critique through FOBAPROA book. Weak relevance to anti-corruption (5B.5) and rule of law (5B.7) but largely political party management content.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0016","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"PRD internal election crisis 1999, Jesús Ortega vs Amalia García contested election, PRD internal fraud allegations, FOBAPROA research publication, 2000 DF government chief election with 34.5% vote. Primarily party internal conflict and electoral politics. FOBAPROA content already covered in adjacent chunks.","exclusion_reason":"Party internal disputes and electoral mechanics; no substantive new economic governance content beyond what appears in adjacent chunks."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0017","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0016","unit-0018"],"explanation":"FOBAPROA research and 'fraude más grande de la historia después de La Conquista' judgment. López Obrador published conclusions of his investigation into Fondo Bancario de Protección al Ahorro, the state bank rescue fund that rescued well-connected bankers and businessmen after 1994 financial crisis, converting their losses into public debt. This is directly about anti-corruption in financial sector (5B.5) and rule-of-law in economic governance (5B.7). Material evidence of López Obrador's economic governance positions on financial sector accountability.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0018","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8"],"relevance_strength":"pivotal","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0017","unit-0019"],"explanation":"DF government 2000-2005: López Obrador as head of government with 34.5% vote. Specific social programs implemented: Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores (Universal Food Pension for the Elderly), the flagship social program of his DF administration. Refusal to implement Seguro Popular on the grounds that Defeños already received free coverage from municipal institutions. Vigorous public works campaign. Material relevance to prosperity agenda (5B.1), budget quality and infrastructure delivery (5B.6), and fair distribution to vulnerable groups (5B.8). This is the first substantive evidence of López Obrador's actual economic governance through social policy.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0019","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0018","unit-0020"],"explanation":"Public image management 2000-2005, 'mañaneras' 6am press conferences, charismatic leadership development, pejelagarto nickname, AMLO acronym. Administrative style content with indirect relevance to governance transparency (5B.7). mañaneras became the signature transparency/communication mechanism of his presidency. Content on rule-of-law accountability in DF government context.","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0020","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0019","unit-0021"],"explanation":"DF government management results: vigorous public works campaign for urban infrastructure improvement, social protection programs including Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores, refusal of Seguro Popular. Some budgetary debt growth but slower than previous governments. Economic governance evidence: specific implemented social programs and infrastructure delivery, relevance to prosperity distribution (5B.1), infrastructure delivery (5B.6), and social distribution (5B.8).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0021","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Continued DF government results assessment: opposition PAN criticism of populist budget spending and debt growth, criminal violence results evaluation. Assessment of government performance from political opponents rather than direct policy content. No new substantive economic governance facts beyond what appears in adjacent chunks.","exclusion_reason":"Political opposition characterizations of DF government; no new substantive economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0022","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0021","unit-0023"],"explanation":"March 2004 videoescándalo: Televisa recordings showing prominent PRD politicians and López Obrador collaborators (Gustavo Ponce Meléndez, René Bejarano, Carlos Ímaz Gispert) engaged in corruption. Carlos Ahumada Kurtz as central figure. Shows corruption practices among López Obrador's close subordinates. The text states 'costaba imaginar que López Obrador no estuviera al corriente de los chanchullos de una persona tan allegada a él como Bejarano.' His reaction was tardy and weak. Direct relevance to anti-corruption enforcement credibility (5B.5) and rule of law (5B.7).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0023","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0022","unit-0024"],"explanation":"Videoescándalo aftermath and PGR desafuero request May 18 2004. López Obrador characterized the scandal as a 'conspiracy' by Salinas, Fernández de Cevallos, and Fox's entorno. The Cuajimalpa land expropriation dispute and legal proceedings. His late and weak reaction to the corruption exposed. Relevance to anti-corruption enforcement credibility (5B.5) and rule of law/institutional integrity (5B.7).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0024","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0023","unit-0025"],"explanation":"Desafuero congressional vote April 7 2005, 360 vs 127. Civil resistance movement. Rafael Macedo de la Concha resignation, Daniel Cabeza de Vaca new prosecutor May 2005, charges dropped May 4 2005. Fox-López Obrador meeting April 27 2005. Political conflict over judicial immunity and rule of law (5B.7). The case was dropped, raising questions about accountability (5B.5).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0025","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0024","unit-0026"],"explanation":"PRD primary candidacy, 'desafuero' resolution, coalition 'Por el Bien de Todos' formation. Book 'Un proyecto alternativo de nación' October 2004 with 20 programmatic points. 200000 perredista demonstration August 2004. Political mobilization and anti-system positioning. Relevant to rule-of-law engagement (5B.7) and anti-corruption credibility (5B.5).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0026","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Desafuero congressional vote mechanics, civil resistance movement details, Assembly Legislative conflict over Supreme Court intervention. Political conflict mechanics without new substantive economic governance content beyond what appears in adjacent chunks. Content primarily about legal/constitutional dispute rather than economic policy.","exclusion_reason":"Legal/constitutional dispute mechanics; no substantive new economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0027","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"April 25 2005 return to office after charges dropped, Fox resignation of prosecutor Rafael Macedo de la Concha, May 4 2005 charges dropped, Fox-López Obrador 20-minute meeting at Los Pinos. Resolution of political conflict without economic governance content.","exclusion_reason":"Political resolution of desafuero conflict; no economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0028","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.2","5B.3","5B.5","5B.6"],"relevance_strength":"pivotal","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0029","unit-0030"],"explanation":"2006 presidential campaign program details: 'austeridad republicana,' anti-corruption platform, salary reduction for president, FOBAPROA investigation, PRD platform economic policies. Concrete economic governance positions: reduction of president's salary by half, investigation of bank rescue fund, combatting privilege and corruption 'from top to bottom.' Relevance to prosperity agenda (5B.1), professional appointments (5B.2 - salary reduction affects appointment quality), fiscal rules (5B.3), anti-corruption (5B.5), budget quality (5B.6).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0029","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Campaign dynamics and electoral competition: Calderón attacks, PAN ads ('López Obrador es un peligro para México'), candidate qualifications contrast, accusations against Calderón about BANOBRAS and Energy Ministry. Electoral campaign tactics and candidate character attacks; no substantive economic governance policy content beyond what appears in adjacent chunks.","exclusion_reason":"Electoral campaign dynamics and candidate character attacks; no substantive new economic governance content beyond adjacent chunks."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0030","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.5"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0028","unit-0031"],"explanation":"2006 PRD platform detailed: 'primero los pobres' slogan, ending privilege/corruption/sack from federal administration, fighting tax fraud and evasion, cutting government spending with first-year savings of 100 billion pesos, social programs for vulnerable groups, agricultural/tourism/public works development, defending constitutional rights to fair wages, NAFTA cooperation and migration policy. Content primarily recaps positions already described in adjacent chunks. No new substantive economic governance content.","exclusion_reason":"Recaps energy and agricultural policy positions from adjacent chunks; no new substantive economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0032","included":false,"relevant_question_ids":[],"relevance_strength":"none","adjacent_chunk_ids":[],"explanation":"Campaign period polling data, electoral competition dynamics, electoral violence and polarization context. No substantive economic governance content.","exclusion_reason":"Polling data and electoral competition dynamics; no substantive economic governance content."},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0033","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0034","unit-0035"],"explanation":"2006 electoral result and TEPJF recount process: PREP results July 3 2006, IFE official count, Calderón 35.89% vs López Obrador 35.31%, 0.58% margin 243934 votes. TEPJF partial recount. International election observation missions confirmed process integrity. EU mission 'descartó cualquier posibilidad de fraude.' Relevance to institutional integrity (5B.7), rule-of-law in elections (5B.4), and post-election conflict governance (5B.5).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0034","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0033","unit-0035"],"explanation":"Post-election conflict: López Obrador's 'gobierno legítimo' declaration, November 20 2006 inauguration ceremony in Zócalo, 'Gobierno alterno' parallel government formation. Electoral result dispute and parallel government institution-building. Institutional conflict with legitimacy challenges relevant to rule-of-law (5B.4, 5B.7) and democratic governance (5B.5).","exclusion_reason":null},{"schema_version":"chunk_routing_decision_v1","source_id":"BOOK-013","source_sha256":"8278f6eaaceb659d4fd8928072c46884f894d0c9826a1752e6ddbef53739da80","chunk_id":"unit-0035","included":true,"relevant_question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7"],"relevance_strength":"material","adjacent_chunk_ids":["unit-0034","unit-0036"],"explanation":"TEPJF partial recount August 2006: 237000 votes annulled, 11.7 million recount, TEPJF validates election with 0.56% margin. 'Se abre el camino a un usurpador.' Intensification of resistance. TEPJF verdict as institutional legitimacy test.
